manual_service_request: Operator creates an SR through the ticket application service using official identity when known or the governed local identity path.
Ticket invariants validate identity uniqueness and accepted manual fields.
SR persists through HLD-02 with HLD-14 audit/history.
Later exact official-source evidence may adopt/enrich the same entity through HLD-05 without replacing internal identity.
link_service_request_to_rfc: Operator/source-review identifies the applicable root/master RFC by immutable identity.
Command rejects a subordinate as the direct target and revalidates hierarchy revision/current identities.
Duplicate link is an idempotent no-op; accepted new link appends relationship history.
Neither SR nor RFC lifecycle state changes because of the relationship command.
Subordinate workbenches derive SR context through the master relationship and preserve subordinate-origin provenance.
manage_rfc_hierarchy: Command captures the exact RFC identities and current hierarchy/customer revisions.
Validator checks one-parent rule, maximum depth two, self/indirect cycle prevention and resolved Customer consistency.
Post-WFM-history reparenting is classified high-risk and retains prior hierarchy history.
Accepted relation mutation commits atomically and all derived root/master/subordinate projections recompute from relationships.
attach_device_reference_to_rfc: RFC command links an existing or newly created operational Device Reference directly to the exact RFC.
The link is valid with or without a Service Request and may differ between master and subordinate RFCs.
Later HLD-09 reconciliation/regularization may resolve the Device Reference to a Network Element.
Resolution never rewrites the RFC relationship to point directly at Network Element or changes Device Reference identity.
source_reconciliation: HLD-05 stages exact source observations and source-owned field proposals against the RFC/SR identity.
Ticket application service applies accepted source-owned changes only after current-state/stale validation.
SOMA-owned relationships, Working Notes and local lifecycle/correction history are protected from source overwrite.
Exact manual identity adoption preserves internal identity, relationships and history.
terminal_rfc_evidence: Accepted provider terminal evidence updates the governed RFC terminal projection/history.
The same atomic acceptance may create/update a pending cascade proposal scoped to the exact current RFC branch but does not execute downstream consequences.
Separate reviewed cascade confirmation revalidates captured scope and coordinates HLD-06 Task/Objective consequences plus HLD-10 Communication consequences.
Failure in any required cascade participant rolls the cascade transaction back according to HLD-14.
archive_restore_rfc: Operator explicitly archives/restores SOMA-local RFC presentation state.
Branch-scoped operation revalidates exact eligible target membership and preserves pre-existing archive states.
Source import/reconciliation continues by exact identity while archived.
Newer active source evidence that conflicts with archive state creates reviewed restoration context rather than silently restoring.
rfc_customer_reconciliation: HLD-05/HLD-03 provide supported Customer evidence and exact candidate matching, with account number stronger than descriptive name.
HLD-04 stages/accepts the RFC Customer proposal and validates resolved branch consistency.
Unresolved ownership remains explicit and does not fabricate hierarchy or block temporal grouping merely because Customer is unknown.
Infrastructure placement never establishes RFC Customer ownership.
working_note_change: Operator creates/edits/removes an exact Working Note under the owning ticket.
Creation identity/time remain stable while edits/removals preserve required historical/audit evidence.
Import processing cannot overwrite or delete Working Notes.

query_rules: Master/root RFC views may project direct SR links; subordinate views project inherited SR context with provenance rather than materializing duplicate joins.
Master/Subordinate/root/standalone roles are always derived from hierarchy relationships.
Ticket workbench Device context resolves through Device Reference and may display Infrastructure resolution as additional projection only.
Archived/terminal/history presentation is a query/projection concern over surviving ticket records, not deletion authority.
